# Pika

> Pika is a customer and product intelligence platform that helps businesses turn observed customer, product and transaction data into understandable opportunities and controlled marketing actions.

Canonical website: https://pika.tr/
Public knowledge base: https://pika.tr/wiki/
Public product definition: https://pika.tr/wiki/pika-nedir
Sitemap: https://pika.tr/sitemap.xml
